title: "Calibration"
claim: "LLMs struggle to give calibrated answers."
---

**LLMs struggle to give calibrated answers.**

LLMs usually are not aware of what they know or do not know.

- @kadavath2022know have found that large-parameter models are fairly well calibrated in standard benchmarks.
- However a recent OpenAI -@openai2024simpleqa study found that models are fairly overconfident on tests of obscure facts:
![](images/image10.png){.column-margin}

- A Metactulus study in October 2024 found that pro human forecasters were "signficantly better" than top bots on a set of 113 forecasting questions across various domains (eg. politics, economics, the rate of technological progress, etc ) and that the bots displayed a positive bias (overestimating the likelihood of all events on average)[^26]. 

[^26]: https://www.metaculus.com/notebooks/28784/aibq3results/
